info.title: Veeam Backup & Replication REST API
info.description:
This document lists paths (endpoints) of the Veeam Backup & Replication REST API and operations that you can perform by sending HTTP requests to the paths.

Requests can contain parameters in their path, query and header. POST and PUT requests can include a request body with a resource payload. In response, you receive a conventional HTTP response code, an HTTP response header and an optional response body schema that contains a result model.

Some request and response bodies refer to reusable schema objects that are defined in the `schemas` section of the REST API specification. Schemas, in turn, may inherit a part of their properties by referring to other schemas, and be polymorphic by referring to multiple alternate schemas.

The **Available to** field lists the built-in roles that can use the endpoint by default. You can also grant access to a custom role: custom roles support backup and restore operations, so a custom role can use any endpoint that requires backup or restore permissions. Endpoints that require other permissions remain available to built-in roles only.

tags.name: Login
tags.description: The authorization process involves obtaining an access token and a refresh token. For details on the authorization process and security settings, see [Authorization and Security](https://helpcenter.veeam.com/references/vbr/13/rest/1.3-rev1/tag/SectionOverview#section/Authorization-and-Security).<SecurityDefinitions />

tags.name: Service
tags.description: The Service section defines operations for retrieving information about the backup server where the REST API service is running.

tags.name: Services
tags.description: The Services section defines a path and operation for retrieving information about associated backend services. You may need to connect to these services for integration with Veeam Backup & Replication.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description: The Credentials section defines operations for managing credentials records that are added to the backup server.

tags.name: Encryption
tags.description: The Encryption section defines operations for managing KMS servers and passwords that are used for data encryption.

tags.name: License
tags.description: The License section defines operations for installing and managing licenses on the backup server.

tags.name: Connection
tags.description: The Connection section defines a path and operation for retrieving a TLS certificate or SSH fingerprint used to establish a secure connection between the backup server and the specified server.

tags.name: Cloud Browser
tags.description: The Cloud Browser section defines operations for retrieving information about cloud compute and storage resources. The Cloud Browser section helps you map a cloud folder with an object storage repository.

tags.name: Inventory Browser
tags.description:
The Inventory Browser section defines operations that allow you to:
  • Retrieve virtualization servers and their virtual infrastructure objects (data centers, clusters, hosts, resource pools, vApps, VMs and so on). In this version, you can browse VMware vSphere, VMware Cloud Director and Microsoft Hyper-V objects.
  • Manage computers, cloud machines, clusters and Active Directory objects with protection groups.
  • Manage unstructured data sources.
  • Manage Microsoft Entra ID tenants.

tags.name: Traffic Rules
tags.description: The Traffic Rules section defines operations for retrieving and editing information about network traffic rules that are configured on the backup server.

tags.name: General Options
tags.description: The General Options section defines operations for retrieving and editing general settings of Veeam Backup & Replication.

tags.name: Users and Roles
tags.description: The Users and Roles section defines operations for managing Veeam Backup & Replication users, groups and assigned roles.

tags.name: ACL
tags.description: The ACL section defines operations for managing access control lists (ACLs) that grant users and roles access to objects on the backup server. You can retrieve the access control list, get an ACL record for a specific object, change the owner of an object and change the effective access permissions for an object.

tags.name: Global Exclusions
tags.description: The Global Exclusions section defines operations for managing which VMs will be excluded from processing, even if they are included in jobs. In this version, you can use these operations for VMware vSphere, VMware Cloud Director and Microsoft Hyper-V VMs.

tags.name: Security
tags.description: The Security section defines operations for managing Security & Compliance Analyzer and getting four-eyes authorization events.

tags.name: Malware Detection
tags.description: The Malware Detection section defines operations for managing malware events, configuring malware detection settings (suspicious file masks, trusted file extensions and indicators of compromise), managing the malware detection state and exclusions of backup objects, scanning backups with antivirus software or YARA rules, and analyzing backups for signs of encryption.

tags.name: Configuration Backup
tags.description: The Configuration Backup section defines operations for managing backup of the configuration database that Veeam Backup & Replication uses.

tags.name: Deployment
tags.description: The Deployment section defines operations for generating and downloading a Veeam Deployment Kit — a package that installs the certificates and components required for certificate-based (passwordless) authentication with the backup server. The kit can include Microsoft Windows, Linux, and Unix packages. Install the kit on components that you add to the backup infrastructure, such as Microsoft Windows managed servers, Microsoft Hyper-V hosts, Guest Interaction proxies, protected Microsoft Windows VMs, and Microsoft Windows, Linux or IBM AIX Veeam Agent computers.

tags.name: Managed Servers
tags.description:
The Managed Servers section defines operations for managing servers.

NOTE
In this version, the REST API supports the following server types: *VMware vSphere*, *Hyper-V*, *Linux* and *Windows*.

tags.name: Repositories
tags.description:
The Repositories section defines operations for managing backup repositories.

NOTE
In this version, the REST API supports the following storage types: direct attached storage (Microsoft Windows and Linux servers), network attached storage (SMB and NFS shares), object storage repositories and Veeam Data Cloud Vault repositories. For details on how to add an object storage repository, see [Object Storage Repositories](https://helpcenter.veeam.com/references/vbr/13/rest/1.3-rev1/tag/SectionHowTo#section/Object-Storage-Repositories).

tags.name: Mount Servers
tags.description: The Mount Servers section defines operations for managing mount servers in your backup infrastructure. Mount servers are used in advanced restore operations (file restore, application item restore and Instant Recovery).

tags.name: Proxies
tags.description:
The Proxies section defines operations for managing backup proxies.

NOTE
In this version, the REST API supports VMware vSphere backup proxies, Microsoft Hyper-V off-host backup proxies and general-purpose backup proxies used with Veeam Agents and unstructured data.

tags.name: WAN Accelerators
tags.description: The WAN Accelerators section defines operations for managing WAN accelerators.

tags.name: Helper Appliance Templates
tags.description: The Helper Appliance Templates section defines operations for deploying, retrieving and removing helper appliance templates. Helper appliances are temporary appliances that Veeam Backup & Replication deploys in a public cloud to perform restore operations to that cloud.

tags.name: High Availability (HA) Cluster
tags.description: The High Availability (HA) Cluster section defines operations for configuring and managing a High Availability cluster of backup servers. You can get the cluster configuration, create, edit and delete the cluster, perform switchover and failover between cluster nodes.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description:
The Jobs section defines operations for managing jobs that are coordinated by the backup server. You can also start a quick backup — an ad-hoc incremental backup that adds a new restore point for an individual VMware vSphere, VMware Cloud Director, Microsoft Hyper-V, or agent-managed machine that already has a backup.

NOTE
In this version, the REST API supports the following job types:
  • `VSphereBackup` — VMware vSphere backup jobs.
  • `VSphereReplica` — VMware vSphere replication jobs.
  • `HyperVBackup` — Microsoft Hyper-V backup jobs.
  • `CloudDirectorBackup` — VMware Cloud Director backup jobs.
  • `NutanixAHVBackupJob` — Nutanix AHV backup jobs.
  • `ProxmoxBackupJob` — Proxmox VE backup jobs.
  • `WindowsAgentBackup` — Veeam Agent backup jobs for Microsoft Windows computers.
  • `LinuxAgentBackup` — Veeam Agent backup jobs for Linux computers.
  • `WindowsAgentBackupFailoverCluster` — Veeam Agent backup jobs for Microsoft Windows failover clusters.
  • `WindowsAgentBackupWorkstationPolicy` — Veeam Agent backup policies for Microsoft Windows computers of the workstation type.
  • `LinuxAgentBackupWorkstationPolicy` — Veeam Agent backup policies for Linux computers of the workstation type.
  • `WindowsAgentBackupServerPolicy` — Veeam Agent backup policies for Microsoft Windows computers of the server type.
  • `LinuxAgentBackupServerPolicy` — Veeam Agent backup policies for Linux computers of the server type.
  • `EntraIDTenantBackup` — Microsoft Entra ID tenant backup jobs.
  • `EntraIDAuditLogBackup` — Microsoft Entra ID audit log backup jobs.
  • `EntraIDTenantBackupCopy` — Microsoft Entra ID tenant backup copy jobs.
  • `FileBackup` — File share backup jobs.
  • `ObjectStorageBackup` — Object storage backup jobs.
  • `CloudBackupAzure` — Veeam Backup for Microsoft Azure backup jobs.
  • `CloudBackupAWS` — Veeam Backup for AWS backup jobs.
  • `CloudBackupGoogle` — Veeam Backup for Google Cloud backup jobs.
  • `SureBackupContentScan` — SureBackup Lite jobs that perform backup verification and content scan only (full recoverability testing in virtual labs is not available). In the current version, SureBackup is supported only for backups created with Veeam Backup for Microsoft Azure, Veeam Backup for AWS, or Veeam Backup for Google Cloud.
  • `BackupCopy` — VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V backup copy jobs.
  • `FileBackupCopy` — Backup copy jobs for file shares.
VMware vSphere jobs can process inventory objects of the following types: *VirtualMachine*, *vCenterServer*, *Datacenter*, *Cluster*, *Host*, *ResourcePool*, *Folder*, *Template*, *Tag*, *Datastore* and *DatastoreCluster*. Inventory objects with multiple tags (*Multitag* type) can only be added to jobs in the Veeam Backup & Replication UI or PowerShell — the REST API only allows you to get and manage jobs that process these objects.

tags.name: Backups
tags.description: The Backups section defines operations for managing backups that are created on or imported to the backup server.

tags.name: Backup Objects
tags.description:
The Backup Objects section defines operations for managing backup objects — VMs and vApps that are included in backups created by the backup server.

Types of backup objects differ depending on the backup job platform:

  • Backups of VMware vSphere jobs contain VMs only.
  • Backups of VMware Cloud Director jobs contain VMs and vApps.

tags.name: Restore Points
tags.description: The Restore Points section defines operations for retrieving restore points created on the backup server and backed up disks from the restore points.

tags.name: Restore
tags.description:
The Restore section defines operations for performing restore.

NOTE
In this version, the REST API supports the following recovery operations:
  • Instant Recovery to VMware vSphere
  • Instant Recovery to Microsoft Hyper-V
  • Instant Recovery of Microsoft Windows and Linux machine backups to Microsoft Azure
  • Instant File Share Recovery to the original or another location
  • Entire VM restore of a VMware vSphere VM backup to VMware vSphere
  • Entire VM restore of a Microsoft Hyper-V VM backup to Microsoft Hyper-V
  • Entire VM restore of a VMware Cloud Director VM backup to VMware Cloud Director
  • Restore of an entire file share, bucket or container backup to the original or another location
  • Restore of disk backups that will be registered as First Class Disks (FCD) — a type of virtual disks that can be managed independent of any VM
  • File restore from a backup or replica of a Microsoft Windows or Linux machine
  • File restore from an unstructured data backup
  • Microsoft Entra ID item restore
  • Microsoft Entra ID audit log restore

tags.name: Application Items Restore
tags.description: The Application Items Restore section defines operations for managing application item restore sessions performed with Veeam Explorers.

tags.name: DiskManagement
tags.description: The Disk Management section defines operations for managing disks and volumes during restore. Within a disk management session, you can load the live disk layout of a target host, automatically or manually map a backup layout onto it, and apply changes such as creating, removing, resizing and restoring partitions. You can also erase disks, unlock BitLocker-protected volumes, and create or revert to checkpoints to discard subsequent modifications.

tags.name: Recovery Media
tags.description: The Recovery Media section defines a path and operation for downloading recovery media that is used for bare metal recovery.

tags.name: Data Integration API
tags.description: The Data Integration API section defines operations for publishing disks from backups and snapshot replicas.

tags.name: Backup Browser
tags.description:
The Backup Browser section defines operations that allow you to:
  • Browse the file system, compare files and folders, and perform file restore.
  • Browse Microsoft Entra ID tenant backups, compare Microsoft Entra ID items, and restore entire items or their properties.
  • Browse the Microsoft Entra ID log files, compare files and folders, and restore Microsoft Entra ID logs.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: The Tasks section defines operations for managing tasks that are used to perform runtime operations (file restore and rescan of inventory objects).

tags.name: Replicas
tags.description: The Replicas section defines operations for managing snapshot replicas.

tags.name: Replica Restore Points
tags.description: The Replica Restore Points section defines operations for managing restore points of snapshot replicas.

tags.name: Failover
tags.description: The Failover section defines operations for managing failover.

tags.name: Failback
tags.description: The Failback section defines operations for managing failback.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: The Sessions section defines operations for managing sessions (except [automation sessions](#/Automation/GetAllAutomationSessions)) and task sessions performed on the backup server.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: The Agents section defines operations for working with protection groups, obtaining protected computers, managing Veeam Agent and other Veeam components on the computers and handling recovery tokens used for bare metal recovery.

tags.name: Active Directory Domains
tags.description: The Active Directory Domains section defines operations for managing Active Directory domains.

tags.name: Automation
tags.description: The Automation section defines operations for granular import and export of objects available in the REST API. It can be useful, for example, if you set up the backup infrastructure using JSON specification or migrate the infrastructure to another backup server. For details, see [Mass Deployment](https://helpcenter.veeam.com/references/vbr/13/rest/1.3-rev1/tag/SectionHowTo#section/Mass-Deployment).

tags.name: Log export
tags.description: The Log Export section defines operations for exporting Veeam Backup & Replication logs.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/serverTime` endpoint gets the current date and time on the backup server.

**Available to**: Anyone.

The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/serverCertificate` endpoint gets a certificate of the backup server.

**Available to**: Anyone.

The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/serverInfo` endpoint returns the Veeam Backup & Replication installation ID, backup server name (or IP address), build number, and cumulative patches installed on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.summary: Register Backup Server on My Account Portal
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/registerVbr` endpoint registers the backup server on the My Account portal.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/services` endpoint gets associated services for integration with Veeam Backup & Replication.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of services to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of services to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts services by one of the service parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts services in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: nameFilter
parameters.description: Filters services by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any service parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/install` endpoint installs a license on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/license` endpoint gets the installed license on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/remove` endpoint removes a license from the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/createReport` endpoint creates a license usage report for the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/renew` endpoint renews the license on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/license/sockets` endpoint gets information about the consumption of socket licenses on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of workloads to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of workloads to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts workloads by one of the socket workload parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts workloads in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: nameFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any workload parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

parameters.name: hostNameFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by hostname.

parameters.name: hostIdFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by host ID.

parameters.name: socketsNumberFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by the number of sockets they use.

parameters.name: coresNumberFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by the number of CPU cores they use.

parameters.name: typeFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by host type.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/sockets/{hostId}/revoke` endpoint revokes a socket license from the host with the specified `hostId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: hostId
parameters.description: ID of the licensed host. To get the host ID, run the [Get Installed License](#/License/GetInstalledLicense) request.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/license/instances` endpoint gets information about instance license consumption on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of workloads to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of workloads to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts workloads by one of the workload parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts workloads in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: nameFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any instance workload parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

parameters.name: hostNameFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by hostname.

parameters.name: usedInstancesNumberFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by the number of consumed instances.

parameters.name: typeFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by workload type.

parameters.name: instanceIdFilter
parameters.description: Filters workloads by instance ID.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/instances/{instanceId}/assign` endpoint sets the product edition for a standalone Veeam Agent with the specified `instanceId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID. To get the instance ID, run the [Get Installed License](#/License/GetInstalledLicense) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/instances/{instanceId}/revoke` endpoint revokes an instance license from the workload that has the specified `instanceId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID. To get the instance ID, run the [Get Installed License](#/License/GetInstalledLicense) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/instances/{instanceId}/remove` endpoint removes a licensed Agent instance from the workload that has the specified `instanceId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID. To get the instance ID, run the [Get Installed License](#/License/GetInstalledLicense) request.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/license/capacity` endpoint gets information about the capacity license instance consumption by file shares and object storage repositories.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.summary: Revoke Capacity License from Unstructured Data Workload
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/capacity/{instanceId}/revoke` endpoint revokes a capacity instance with the specified `instanceId` from an unstructured data workload (file share or object storage).

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID. To get the instance ID, run the [Get Installed License](#/License/GetInstalledLicense) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/update` endpoint manually updates your license.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.summary: Enable or Disable License Auto Update
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/autoupdate` endpoint enables or disables automatic update of the installed license.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.summary: Enable or Disable Instance Consumption for Unlicensed Agents
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/license/agentConsumption` endpoint enables or disables unlicensed standalone agents to consume instances.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/securityAnalyzer/start` endpoint starts Security & Compliance Analyzer on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Security Administrator.

201.description: A `SecurityComplianceAnalyzer` session has been created to start Security & Compliance Analyzer. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

get.summary: Get Security & Compliance Analyzer Last Run
get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/securityAnalyzer/lastRun` endpoint gets the last session of Security & Compliance Analyzer.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Security Administrator.

The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/securityAnalyzer/schedule` endpoint gets the Security & Compliance Analyzer schedule.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Security Administrator.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/securityAnalyzer/schedule` endpoint modifies the Security & Compliance Analyzer schedule.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Security Administrator.

post.summary: Reset All Security & Compliance Analyzer Statuses
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/securityAnalyzer/bestPractices/resetAll` endpoint restores default compliance statuses for all Security & Compliance Analyzer best practices.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Security Administrator.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/securityAnalyzer/bestPractices` endpoint gets best practices compliance result from the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Security Administrator.

post.summary: Suppress Security & Compliance Analyzer Best Practice Status
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/securityAnalyzer/bestPractices/{id}/suppress` endpoint suppresses a Security & Compliance Analyzer best practice compliance status that has the specified best practice `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Security Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Best practice ID. To get the ID, run the [Get Security & Compliance Analyzer Results](#/Security/GetBestPracticesComplianceResult) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/securityAnalyzer/bestPractices/{id}/reset` endpoint resets the compliance status of a Security & Compliance Analyzer best practice that has the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Security Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Best practice ID. To get the ID, run the [Get Security & Compliance Analyzer Results](#/Security/GetBestPracticesComplianceResult) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/oauth2/token` endpoint gets an access token and a refresh token.

**Available to**: All built-in and custom roles.

The HTTP POST request to the `/api/oauth2/logout` endpoint performs a logout operation. After you log out, your access and refresh tokens become invalid.

**Available to**: All user roles.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/trafficRules` endpoint gets network traffic rules that control traffic transferred between backup infrastructure components.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/trafficRules` endpoint edits network traffic rules that are configured on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

201.description: An `Infrastructure` session has been created to edit the traffic rules. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions` endpoint gets Veeam Backup & Replication settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions` endpoint edits Veeam Backup & Replication settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/emailSettings` endpoint gets Veeam Backup & Replication email settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/emailSettings` endpoint edits Veeam Backup & Replication email settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/emailSettings/testMessage` endpoint sends a test email notification using the configured settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

204.description: Test email notification has been sent.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/emailSettings/checkSmtpConnection` endpoint checks the SMTP server certificate.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/hostAuthentication` endpoint gets Veeam Backup & Replication host authentication settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/hostAuthentication` endpoint edits Veeam Backup & Replication host authentication settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.summary: Export Trusted Hosts List to a File
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/hostAuthentication/exportTrustedHosts` endpoint exports trusted hosts to a file using the configured settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

204.description: Trusted hosts list has been exported to the requested file.

post.summary: Import Trusted Hosts List from a File
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/hostAuthentication/importTrustedHosts` endpoint imports trusted hosts from a file using the configured settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

200.description: Trusted hosts list has been imported from the requested file.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/notifications` endpoint gets Veeam Backup & Replication notifications settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/notifications` endpoint edits Veeam Backup & Replication notification settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/eventForwarding` endpoint gets Veeam Backup & Replication event forwarding settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/eventForwarding` endpoint edits Veeam Backup & Replication event forwarding settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/storageLatency` endpoint gets storage latency settings configured for backup and replication operations. Storage latency control allows you to limit Input/Output operations on the production storage where protected machines reside.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/storageLatency` endpoint edits storage latency settings configured for backup and replication operations. Storage latency control allows you to limit Input/Output operations on the production storage where protected machines reside.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.summary: Add Latency Settings for Specific Datastore
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/storageLatency/datastores` endpoint adds custom latency settings for a specific datastore.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

201.description: Datastore latency settings record has been added.

get.summary: Get Latency Settings for Specific Datastore
get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/storageLatency/datastores/{id}` endpoint gets custom latency settings configured for a specific datastore.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of a datastore latency settings record. To get the ID, run the  [Get Storage Latency Settings](#/General-Options/GetStorageLatencySettings) request.

put.summary: Edit Latency Settings for Specific Datastore
put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/storageLatency/datastores/{id}` endpoint edits custom latency settings configured for a specific datastore.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of a datastore latency settings record. To get the ID, run the  [Get Storage Latency Settings](#/General-Options/GetStorageLatencySettings) request.

delete.summary: Remove Latency Settings for Specific Datastore
delete.description:
The HTTP DELETE request to the `/api/v1/generalOptions/storageLatency/datastores/{id}` endpoint removes custom latency settings configured for a specific datastore.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of a datastore latency settings record. To get the ID, run the  [Get Storage Latency Settings](#/General-Options/GetStorageLatencySettings) request.

204.description: Datastore latency settings record is deleted.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/security/users` endpoint gets an array of users and groups, along with their assigned roles.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of users and groups to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of users and groups to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/backupInfrastructure/managedServers` endpoint adds a server to the backup infrastructure.

If you want to add a Microsoft Hyper-V cluster and include only specific Microsoft Hyper-V hosts, follow these steps:

  1. Add the credentials used to connect to the Microsoft Hyper-V cluster: [Add Credentials Record](#/Credentials/CreateCreds). You will need to specify the credentials ID in the following requests.
  2. Discover the hosts managed by the cluster: [Get Microsoft Hyper-V Servers Managed by Microsoft Hyper-V Cluster or SCVMM Server](#/Managed-Servers/ResolveHyperVHosts).
  3. Add the Microsoft Hyper-V cluster using this request. In the request body, specify the necessary hosts.

If you want to add an SCVMM server and include only specific Microsoft Hyper-V hosts, follow these steps:

  1. Add the credentials used to connect to the SCVMM server: [Add Credentials Record](#/Credentials/CreateCreds). You will need to specify the credentials ID in the following requests.
  2. To add an SCVMM server without hosts, use this request and set `addAllServers` to `false` in the request body .
  3. Discover the hosts managed by the SCVMM server: [Get Microsoft Hyper-V Servers Managed by Microsoft Hyper-V Cluster or SCVMM Server](#/Managed-Servers/ResolveHyperVHosts).
  4. To add the necessary hosts, edit the SCVMM server: [Edit Server](#/Managed-Servers/UpdateManagedServer).

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

post.description:

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/backups/{id}/objects/moveTo` endpoint moves backup objects (virtual or physical machines) from a backup with the specified `id` to a specified target job.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.description: Backup ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Backups](#/Backups/GetAllBackups) request.

parameters.name: moveAssociatedBackupCopies
parameters.description: If `true`, moving backups between primary backup jobs will also move backups between the associated backup copy jobs, preventing a new full backup from being created for the impacted backup copy job on its next run. The request is rejected with HTTP 400 if the source or target job has more than one associated backup copy job — in that case move the affected backup copies manually between the copy jobs. For other topologies where automatic move is not supported (no associated backup copy jobs are found, or any associated backup copy job uses a cloud repository), the flag is silently ignored, only the primary backup is moved, and a warning is added to the session log. Note: if any moved backup is used as a source by another backup copy job, a new full backup will still be created for that impacted backup copy job on its next run.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/backupObjects/{id}/createRecoveryMedia` endpoint starts an asynchronous task that creates Veeam Recovery Media for a backup created by Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows. The endpoint returns a task that you can poll through the [Get Task](#/Tasks/GetTask) request to track progress and surface failures. To download the resulting ISO file once the task completes successfully, run the [Download Recovery Media](#/Recovery-Media/DownloadRecoveryMedia) request.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backupObjects/{id}/createRecoveryMedia` endpoint creates Veeam Recovery Media for a backup created by Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows. The request will create an ISO file that you can boot from in case the computer stops working or the hard disk fails.

You can also create Veeam Recovery Media for a computer in a protection group. For more information, see [Create Recovery Media for Discovered Entity](#/Agents/CreateRecoveryMediaForDiscoveredEntity).

**Deprecated**: this synchronous endpoint blocks while the ISO is being created and returns a generic HTTP 500 on failure. Use the [Create Recovery Media Task for Backup Object](#/Backup-Objects/CreateRecoveryMediaTaskForBackupObject) request followed by the [Download Recovery Media](#/Recovery-Media/DownloadRecoveryMedia) request instead.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

post.summary: Start Instant Recovery to Microsoft Azure
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/instantRecovery/azure/vm` endpoint starts Instant Recovery of a Linux or Microsoft Windows machine to Microsoft Azure.
NOTE
Deploying a helper appliance template with REST API is not supported in this version. Before you run this request, you must deploy a helper appliance template in the Veeam Backup & Replication UI or with the `Deploy-VBRAzureApplianceTemplate` cmdlet.

To get the values required in the request body, run the following requests:

  1. Run the [Get All Restore Points](#/Restore-Points/GetAllObjectRestorePoints) request to get the `RestorePointId` property value.
  2. Run the [Get Restore Point Disks](#/Restore-Points/GetObjectRestorePointDisksWithFiltering) request to get the `diskUid` property value.
  3. Run the [Get All Cloud Credentials](#/Credentials/GetAllCloudCreds) request to get the `subscriptionId` property value. Use the ID that Veeam Backup & Replication assigned to the Microsoft Azure subscription. You can find this ID in the `data[x].subscription.subscriptions[y].id` property, where `x` and `y` are the ordinal numbers of the objects in the arrays.
  4. Run the [Get Cloud Hierarchy](#/Cloud-Browser/BrowseCloudEntity) request to get the values for the remaining required properties.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/restore/instantRecovery/azure/vm/{mountId}/switchoverSettings` endpoint modifies switchover settings for an Instant Recovery mount point that has the specified `mountID`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: mountId
parameters.description: Mount point ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Mount Points for Instant Recovery to Microsoft Azure](#/Restore/GetAllAzureInstantVMRecoveryMounts) request.

201.description: The switchover settings have been updated.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/instantRecovery/azure/vm/{mountId}/switchover` endpoint starts switchover for a mount point that has the specified `mountID`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: mountId
parameters.description: Mount point ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Mount Points for Instant Recovery to Microsoft Azure](#/Restore/GetAllAzureInstantVMRecoveryMounts) request.

201.description: An `AzureInstantRecoverySwitchover` session has been started to initiate a VM switchover. To check the progress, track the mount `state`.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/vmRestore/vSphere` endpoint performs entire VM restore of a VMware vSphere VM to VMware vSphere. You can restore a VM from the specified restore point to the original location with initial VM settings, or to any location but with different settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: Restore session has been created. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

post.summary: Restore Entire VMware Cloud Director VM
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/vmRestore/cloudDirector` endpoint performs entire VM restore of a VMware Cloud Director VM to VMware Cloud Director. You can restore a VM from the specified restore point to the original location with initial VM settings, or to any location but with different settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: A `RestoreVm` session has been created. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/vmRestore/hyperV` endpoint performs entire VM restore of a Microsoft Hyper-V VM to Microsoft Hyper-V. You can restore a VM from the specified restore point to the original location with initial VM settings, or to any location but with different settings.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: Restore session has been created. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/restore/instantRecovery/vSphere/fcd` endpoint gets an array of FCD mount points.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Backup Operator, Restore Operator, Backup Viewer. Also available to custom roles that have backup or restore permissions.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of mount points to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of mount points to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts mount points by one of the mount point parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts mount points in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: stateFilter
parameters.description: Filters mount points by mount point state.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/instantRecovery/vSphere/fcd` endpoint starts Instant FCD Recovery from the restore point to the destination cluster.

Specify the destination cluster in the `destinationCluster` parameter of the request body as a model of the VMware vSphere object. For details on how to get the cluster model, see [Get Inventory Objects](#/Inventory-Browser/GetInventoryObjects).

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: Instant FCD Recovery has been started. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/restore/instantRecovery/vSphere/fcd/{mountId}` endpoint gets information about the mounted vPower NFS datastore, such as restore session ID, mount point state, instant FCD recovery settings and disks that will be recovered.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Backup Operator, Restore Operator, Backup Viewer. Also available to custom roles that have backup or restore permissions.

parameters.name: mountId
parameters.description: Mount point ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All FCD Mount Points](#/Restore/GetAllVmwareFcdInstantRecoveryMountModels) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/instantRecovery/vSphere/fcd/{mountId}/dismount` endpoint stops publishing the recovered FCDs and removes the disks from the datastore.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: mountId
parameters.description: Mount point ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All FCD Mount Points](#/Restore/GetAllVmwareFcdInstantRecoveryMountModels) request.

200.description: The disks have been unmounted. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/instantRecovery/vSphere/fcd/{mountId}/migrate` endpoint starts migration of FCDs from the specified mount point.

In the request body, specify FCD migration configuration:

  • Disks for migration
  • Target datastore
  • Storage policy that will be applied to the migrated disks
For details on how to get models of the datastore and storage policy, see [Get Inventory Objects](#/Inventory-Browser/GetInventoryObjects).

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: mountId
parameters.description: Mount point ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All FCD Mount Points](#/Restore/GetAllVmwareFcdInstantRecoveryMountModels) request.

200.description: FCD Migration has been started. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/agents/recoveryTokens` endpoint gets an array of all recovery tokens.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of recovery tokens to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of recovery tokens to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts recovery tokens by one of the parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts recovery tokens in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: nameFilter
parameters.description: Filters recovery tokens by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any repository parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/agents/recoveryTokens` endpoint creates a new recovery token.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: Recovery token has been created.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/agents/recoveryTokens/{id}` endpoint gets a recovery token that has the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Recovery token ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Recovery Tokens](#/Agents/GetAllComputerRecoveryTokens) request.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/agents/recoveryTokens/{id}` endpoint edits settings of a recovery token that has the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Recovery token ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Recovery Tokens](#/Agents/GetAllComputerRecoveryTokens) request.

delete.description:
The HTTP DELETE request to the `/api/v1/agents/recoveryTokens/{id}` endpoint deletes a recovery token that has the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Recovery token ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Recovery Tokens](#/Agents/GetAllComputerRecoveryTokens) request.

204.description: Token has been deleted.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/agents/protectedComputers` endpoint gets an array of all protected Linux computers.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of protected computers to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of protected computers to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts protected computers by one of the protected computer parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts protected computers in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: nameFilter
parameters.description: Filters protected computers by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any protected computer parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

parameters.name: typeFilter
parameters.description: Filters protected computers by protected computer type.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/agents/protectedComputers/{id}` endpoint gets a protected Linux computer that has the specified `id`.

parameters.name: id

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/agents/discoveredEntities` endpoint gets an array of discovered entities across all protection groups.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of discovered entities to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of discovered entities to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts discovered entities by one of the discovered entity parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: Sorts discovered entities in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: nameFilter
parameters.description: Filters discovered entities by the `nameFilter` pattern. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning and/or at the end.

parameters.name: ipAddressFilter
parameters.description: Filters discovered entities by the `ipAddressFilter` pattern.

parameters.name: stateFilter
parameters.description: Filters discovered entities by their states.

parameters.name: agentStatusFilter

parameters.name: driverStatusFilter
parameters.description: Filters discovered entities by the installed driver status.

parameters.name: permissionScope
parameters.description: Permission scope type (advanced RBAC) for filtering discovered entities across all protection groups. Must be specified for custom roles. If the value is `Any`, entities are returned if valid under any permission scope.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/agents/discoveredEntities/states` endpoint gets an array of all agent states.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of agent states to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of agent states to return.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts agent states in ascending order.

parameters.name: nameFilter
parameters.description: Filters agent states by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any agent state parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/agents/discoveredEntities/states/{id}` endpoint gets an agent state that has the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the agent.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/agents/discoveredEntities/{id}/backups` endpoint gets an array of backups owned by the agent with the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have backup or restore permissions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the agent.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of backups to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of backups to return.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/agents/discoveredEntities/{id}/attachBackup` endpoint attaches backup ownership to the agent with the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the agent.

requestBody.description: Array of backup IDs to attach.

204.description: Backups have been attached to the agent.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/agents/discoveredEntities/{id}/detachBackup` endpoint detaches backup ownership from the agent with the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the agent.

requestBody.description: Array of backup IDs to detach.

204.description: Backups have been detached from the agent.

post.description:

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/automation/sessions` endpoint gets an array of all automation sessions performed on the backup server.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Backup Operator, Restore Operator, Backup Viewer, Security Administrator. Also available to custom roles that have backup or restore permissions.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of sessions to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of sessions to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts sessions by one of the session parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts sessions in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: nameFilter
parameters.description: Filters sessions by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any session parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning, at the end or both.

parameters.name: createdAfterFilter
parameters.description: Returns sessions that are created after the specified date and time.

parameters.name: createdBeforeFilter
parameters.description: Returns sessions that are created before the specified date and time.

parameters.name: endedAfterFilter
parameters.description: Returns sessions that are finished after the specified date and time.

parameters.name: endedBeforeFilter
parameters.description: Returns sessions that are finished before the specified date and time.

parameters.name: typeFilter
parameters.description: Filters sessions by session type.

parameters.name: stateFilter
parameters.description: Filters sessions by session state.

parameters.name: resultFilter
parameters.description: Filters sessions by session result.

parameters.name: jobIdFilter
parameters.description: Filters sessions by job ID.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/automation/sessions/{id}` endpoint gets an automation session that has the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Backup Operator, Restore Operator, Backup Viewer, Security Administrator. Also available to custom roles that have backup or restore permissions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Automation session ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Automation Sessions](#/Automation/GetAllAutomationSessions) request.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/automation/sessions/{id}/logs` endpoint gets an array of log records of an automation session that has the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Backup Operator, Restore Operator, Backup Viewer, Security Administrator. Also available to custom roles that have backup or restore permissions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Automation session ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Automation Sessions](#/Automation/GetAllAutomationSessions) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/automation/sessions/{id}/stop` endpoint stops an automation session that has the specified `id`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Backup Operator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have backup or restore permissions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Automation session ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All Automation Sessions](#/Automation/GetAllAutomationSessions) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/flr` endpoint starts file restore from a backup or replica of a Microsoft Windows or Linux machine. The operation starts a file restore session and mounts the machine file system to a mount point.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: File system has been mounted.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/flr/{sessionId}/unmount` endpoint unmounts the file system from a mount point and stops a file restore session that has the specified `sessionId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Restore session ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All File Restore Mount Points](#/Backup-Browser/GetAllFlrBrowseSessions) request.

201.description: Restore session has been stopped.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/flr/{sessionId}/validateCredentials` endpoint validates the target machine credentials in a restore session that has the specified `sessionId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Restore session ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All File Restore Mount Points](#/Backup-Browser/GetAllFlrBrowseSessions) request.

post.summary: Validate FLR Restore Item Target Path
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/flr/{sessionId}/validateRestoreItemTargetPath` endpoint checks whether a target path needs to be provided for the specified file-level restore item. Call this endpoint after the target machine credentials have been validated.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Restore session ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All File Restore Mount Points](#/Backup-Browser/GetAllFlrBrowseSessions) request.

post.summary: Get User Code for Delegated Restore of Microsoft Entra ID Items
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/tenant/deviceCode` endpoint obtains a user code required to get credentials for delegated restore of Microsoft Entra ID items.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: User and device codes have been received.

post.summary: Get Credentials for Delegated Restore of Microsoft Entra ID Items
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/tenant/deviceCode/state` endpoint gets credentials that are required for delegated restore of Microsoft Entra ID items. Before you request the credentials, obtain a user code using the [Get User Code for Delegated Restore of Microsoft Entra ID Items](#/Restore/GetEntraIdTenantRestoreDeviceCode) request.

You can use the credentials in the following requests:

  • [Restore Microsoft Entra ID Items](#/Backup-Browser/RestoreEntraIdTenantItems)
  • [Restore Microsoft Entra ID Item Properties](#/Backup-Browser/RestoreEntraIdTenantItemAttributes)

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

get.summary: Get Redirect URI for Delegated Restore of Microsoft Entra ID Items
get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/tenant/{sessionId}/authCode/startAuthorization` endpoint obtains a redirect URI required to perform authorization code flow for delegated restore of Microsoft Entra ID items.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

"

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Mount session ID.

parameters.name: vdcSessionId
parameters.description: Veeam Data Cloud session ID.

parameters.name: redirectUri
parameters.description: Application redirect URI (where code will be redirected to).

post.summary: Perform Authorization Code Exchange for Delegated Restore of Microsoft Entra ID Items
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/tenant/authCode/authorize` endpoint performs code exchange part of authorization code flow for delegated restore of Microsoft Entra ID items.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

"

200.description: Authorization code exchange has been successful.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/tenant` endpoint mounts a Microsoft Entra ID tenant from its backup and starts a mount session required for Microsoft Entra ID tenant restore.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: Tenant has been mounted.

post.summary: Start Microsoft Entra ID Tenant Restore from Copy
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/tenant/fromCopy` endpoint starts restore from backup copy for a Microsoft Entra ID tenant.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: An `EntraIdRestoreFromCopy` session has been created to start restore from backup copy for a Microsoft Entra ID tenant. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/tenant/{sessionId}/stop` endpoint unmounts a Microsoft Entra ID tenant and stops a mount session that has the specified `sessionId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Mount session ID.

201.description: Mount session has been stopped.

post.summary: Start Microsoft Entra ID Audit Log Restore
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/auditLog` endpoint starts the Microsoft Entra ID audit log restore from a backup of Microsoft Entra ID audit logs. The operation starts a file restore session and mounts the log files to a mount point.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: Log files have been mounted.

post.summary: Unmount Microsoft Entra ID Audit Logs
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/entraId/auditLog/{sessionId}/unmount` endpoint unmounts Microsoft Entra ID log files from a mount point and stops a file restore session that has the specified `sessionId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Restore session ID.

201.description: Restore session has been stopped.

get.summary: Get All Disk Publishing Mount Points
get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/dataIntegration` endpoint gets an array of mount points for disk publishing operations.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of mount points to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of mount points to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts mount points by one of the mount point parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts mount points in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

parameters.name: stateFilter
parameters.description: Filters mount points by mount point state.

parameters.name: modeFilter
parameters.description: Filters mount points by mount mode.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/dataIntegration/publish` endpoint starts a disk publishing session.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: A `PublishBackupContentViaMount` session has been started to publish disks. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/dataIntegration/{mountId}` endpoint gets a disk publishing mount point that has the specified `mountID`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: mountId
parameters.description: Mount point ID.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/dataIntegration/{mountId}/unpublish` endpoint stops publishing a mount point that has the specified `mountID`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: mountId
parameters.description: Mount point ID.

200.description: A `PublishBackupContentViaMount` session has been started to unpublish disks. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

get.summary: Get All File Restore Mount Points
get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backupBrowser/flr` endpoint gets an array of all active file restore mount points.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: Number of mount points to skip.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of mount points to return.

parameters.name: orderColumn
parameters.description: Sorts mount points by one of the mount point parameters.

parameters.name: orderAsc
parameters.description: If `true`, sorts mount points in ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backupBrowser/flr/{sessionId}` endpoint gets a file restore mount point that was created by a restore session that has the specified `sessionId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Restore session ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All File Restore Mount Points](#/Backup-Browser/GetAllFlrBrowseSessions) request.

get.description:
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/backupBrowser/flr/{sessionId}/audit` endpoint gets an aggregated view of items restored during a restore session that has the specified `sessionId`.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Restore session ID. To get the ID, run the [Get All File Restore Mount Points](#/Backup-Browser/GetAllFlrBrowseSessions) request.

post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/backupBrowser/flr/{sessionId}/browse` endpoint browses file system items (drives, folders, files and links) available in a restore session that has the specified `sessionId`.

You can use this request in the following cases:

  • To browse the file system before you restore an item
  • To check the item state (changed, not changed, and so on) after you have compared the item in the backup and on the production machine

The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/backupBrowser/entraIdTenant/{sessionId}/compare` endpoint compares the properties of a Microsoft Entra ID item available in a mount session that has the specified `sessionId`.

You can compare item properties either between 2 restore points or between a restore point and production. To compare the item to production, do not specify `newRestorePointId`.

This request is synchronous, meaning that the client will wait until comparison results are ready. Alternatively, you can use an asynchronous request that returns a comparison session immediately so the client can continue execution, and you can process the comparison results later when the session changes its state to `Success`. For details on the asynchronous request, see [Start Comparing Microsoft Entra ID Item Properties](#/Backup-Browser/StartCompareEntraIdTenantItem).

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

You can compare item properties either between 2 restore points or between a restore point and production. To compare the item to production, do not specify `newRestorePointId`.

This request is asynchronous, meaning that the request returns a comparison session immediately so the client can continue execution, and you can process the comparison results later when the session changes its state to `Success`. To get the comparison results, run the [Get Comparison Results for Microsoft Entra ID Items](#/Backup-Browser/GetCompareEntraIdTenantItemResult) request. For details on synchronous request, see [Compare Microsoft Entra ID Item Properties](#/Backup-Browser/CompareEntraIdTenantItem).

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

post.summary: Install CBT Driver on Discovered Entities
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/agents/protectionGroups/{id}/discoveredEntities/installCBTDriver` endpoint installs the Changed Block Tracking (CBT) driver on discovered entities in the protection group that has the specified `id`.

This operation may be required, for example, if you want to evaluate driver performance on a selected computer rather than deploy the driver to all computers in the protection group at once. To enable the CBT driver after installation, reboot the computer.

Consider the following:

  • This request is available only for computers that are protected with Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows.
  • This request is not available for computers in protection groups with pre-installed agents. In this case, use the Veeam Agent Configurator instead.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Protection group ID. To get the protection group ID, run the [Get Protection Groups](#/Agents/GetAllProtectionGroups) request.

The endpoint returns a task that you can poll through the [Get Task](#/Tasks/GetTask) request to track progress and surface failures. To download the resulting ISO file once the task completes successfully, run the [Download Recovery Media](#/Recovery-Media/DownloadRecoveryMedia) request.

The request will create an ISO file that you can boot from in case the computer stops working or the hard disk fails.

You can also create Veeam Recovery Media for a backup created by Veeam Agent for Microsoft Windows. For more information, see [Create Recovery Media for Backup Object](#/Backup-Objects/CreateRecoveryMediaForBackupObject).

**Deprecated**: this synchronous endpoint blocks while the ISO is being created and returns a generic HTTP 500 on failure. Use the [Create Recovery Media Task for Discovered Entity](#/Agents/CreateRecoveryMediaTaskForDiscoveredEntity) request followed by the [Download Recovery Media](#/Recovery-Media/DownloadRecoveryMedia) request instead.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/diskManagement/{diskManagementSessionId}/restorePartition` endpoint restores a partition from the original backup disk to the target disk.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

200.description: The partition has been restored from the backup to the target disk.

post.summary: Starts Volume Restore for Agent or Recovery Appliance
post.description:
The HTTP POST request to the `/api/v1/restore/startVolumeRestore` endpoint starts Volume Restore for Agent or Recovery Appliance.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

201.description: A session has been created to restore volumes. To check the progress, track the session `state`.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/diskManagement/unlockVolume` endpoint unlocks the selected BitLocker-protected volume.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

200.description: Result of the volume unlock attempt.

put.description:
The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/diskManagement/{diskManagementSessionId}/createCheckPoint` endpoint creates a checkpoint of the current restore layout state so that subsequent modifications can be reverted and discarded.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

The HTTP PUT request to the `/api/v1/diskManagement/{diskManagementSessionId}/revertToCheckPoint` endpoint reverts the restore layout state to the previously created checkpoint and discards all modifications made since that point.

**Available to**: Backup Administrator, Restore Operator. Also available to custom roles that have restore permissions.

200.description: Restore layout state after reverting to the checkpoint.

x-enumDescriptions.Specific: Use this mode to scan a specific restore point. Requires the `restorePointId` field.
